sections.text:
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection I1 for Siemens gas Turbine Generator carbon brushes, 
which must be performed on weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Mohamed Fouad tested by eng. Wageh Khalil, revised by MDEPC quality 
control eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Ali Zahran and approved by 
eng. 
Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC 
 quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
 Mohammed Nageb quality control head sector.

items: A work permit must be issued.

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.

Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.

Check the carbon brushes length during operation without removing the brush holder by inserting a gage 
 stick of insulating materials into the bore of the telescopic plunger. The gage stick is provided with 
 several notch marks showing the useful length of the carbon brush.

By visual inspection, make sure 
 that no spark (brushes are matched with slip rings).
